--CETAS
--CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS SELECT

--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas_2
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue_2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas_2;


-- order of execution--
--first data fetched from select query
--create an external source folder
-- then create the external table on the created folder
